summary: Auth Testing Complete - Iteration 238. All core auth flows work correctly: fresh registration, login with new account, login with existing accounts (reviewer@bidblitz.ae, agimk@me.com). Backend API tests pass (16/17). CRITICAL BUG FOUND: Invalid login credentials do NOT show visible error message to user - the error is immediately cleared by a faulty useEffect in AuthPage.jsx.

minor.issue: Returns 404 (not critical, health endpoint may not exist)

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Invalid login credentials show NO visible error message. User has no feedback that login failed. Root cause: useEffect on lines 99-104 clears error immediately after it's set because it checks if fields have values (which they do after user fills form), not if values changed.
ui_bugs.root_cause: useEffect(() => { if (!user.error) return; if ((email || password || ...) && typeof user.clearError === 'function') { user.clearError(); } }, [email, password, ...]); - This clears error immediately because email/password already have values when error is set
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Change useEffect to track previous values and only clear error when user actually types new characters, not just when fields have values

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: AuthPage.jsx lines 99-104 - useEffect clears error immediately after it's set. Change logic to only clear error when user actually types new input, not when fields already have values
Suggested fix: Track previous email/password values with useRef and only clear error when values actually change from previous
critical_code_review_comments: AuthPage.jsx useEffect (lines 99-104) has faulty logic - clears error when fields have values instead of when values change
UserContext.jsx SET_LOADING action also clears error (line 94) which is correct, but combined with the useEffect bug causes error to never be visible
